title: Stoker Classification
description: Coal stokers classified on basis of coal burning capacities according to ASHRAE standards. Determines stoker class based on coal burning capacity in lbs/hour.

components.content:
## Optimal Operating Conditions

**Bituminous Coal Specifications:**
- Ash fusion temperature: 2200°F to 2600°F (ideal range)

**Coal Size Requirements:**
- Recommended size range: 3/4-inch to 1 1/4-inch
- Size varies depending on stoker construction

**Coal Treatment:**
- Oil treatment is common to reduce dust problems
- Oil treatment extends lifetime of mechanical conveyors and feed screws
- Helps reduce wear on mechanical components
